## How to verify

1. `git checkout homework-1-submission && cd homework-1`
2. `npm i && cp .env.example .env`
3. `npm run dev` → http://localhost:3000
4. `npm test` (unit + integration)
5. `npm run test:e2e` (Postman/Newman)
6. Live: https://www.here.now
